title: The Alcubierre warp bubble, measured: curvature, energy conditions and the bill
description: The Alcubierre metric differentiated to give its Einstein tensor, in the frame that moves with the bubble: the expansion contracts ahead and expands behind, the energy density is zero on the axis and negative in the wall, the null energy condition is violated at every sampled point of the wall, and the total is about one Jupiter mass of negative energy for a 10 m bubble at the speed of light. A turntable render of the negative-energy shell and three maps.

metrics.name: closed_form_relative_error
metrics.how: the numeric T^00 against Alcubierre's -(v^2/32pi)(y^2+z^2)/r^2 (df/dr)^2, over 12 866 points in the wall

metrics.name: total_negative_energy
metrics.how: integral of T^00 over a 60 m box, converted with c^2/G; -9.53e-4 solar masses, 1.00 Jupiter masses

metrics.name: null_energy_minimum
metrics.how: the most negative T_ab k^a k^b over a sphere of null directions, at each of the 12 866 wall points

metrics.name: expansion_peak
metrics.how: the York time v_s (x-x_s)/r_s f'(r_s) at x = +R, contracting ahead of the bubble

metrics.name: interior_curvature_leak
metrics.how: peak |G| inside the bubble at r = 0.3 R, as a fraction of the peak in the wall
